items.title: Famous outback race claims another life after serious motorbike crash
items.description: A motorbike rider has died in the Central Australian outback after a Finke Desert Race crash, with the two-day event expected to continue as police investigate.

items.title: Who gets to write symphonies beyond Beethoven and why it matters
items.description: Beethoven's Ninth has topped the ABC Classic 100 countdown for the fifth time. We explore its mystique and shed light on composers following in Beethoven's footsteps.

items.title: Pauline Hanson tells Ben Roberts-Smith supporters she's 'walked in his shoes'
items.description: Pauline Hanson says, like Ben Roberts-Smith, she knows what it's like to face a criminal trial.

items.title: Daniel Turpin named as diver killed in WA shark attack
items.description: The family of a 35-year-old diver who died after being bitten by a shark has described him as "an adored husband, son, brother and uncle who had a lifelong love and deep respect for the ocean".

items.title: SA Police investigating after man dies after 'ineffective' taser arrest
items.description: Police are investigating an incident at Clare, in South Australia's mid north, where a man became unresponsive during an arrest.

items.title: As rape allegations engulf MAFS UK, Channel 4's former boss says the risks were always there
items.description: Married at First Sight UK could be axed as its broadcaster, Channel 4, awaits an external review into the program and serious rape allegations before "deciding what happens next".

items.title: Live: Swans win last-gasp thriller despite Ryan's mark of the year contender
items.description: Jai Serong kicks a last-minute goal to earn Sydney a two-point win over St Kilda, after the Swans had trailed by as many as 33 points in the first half. Follow live.

items.title: 'Embarrassing' Tigers humiliated by Penrith, Sharks down Dragons
items.description: The Penrith Panthers thrash Wests 68-0 to record the biggest win in club history, as Cronulla notches a 34-12 victory over St George Illawarra at Shark Park.

items.title: Inside a Trump-linked plan to turn a communist-era military base into a luxe resort
items.description: Ivanka Trump has floated "manifestations" of luxury holidays. Meanwhile, Albanians are claiming "irreversible" ecological damage. Why protests are shaking Albania.

items.title: 'Happening in every university': Students sent to Putin's 'meat grinder'
items.description: Lessons look a little different at some universities and technical colleges around Russia this year, as the Kremlin tries to entice students to enlist in the military to cover massive casualties in Ukraine.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
